about: Curated registry of Bangladeshi publications and international Bengali/English news services. Domains were curated by hand and restricted to publishers whose official address the maintainer is confident about. A feed is only marked feedClaim=verified_working after scripts/probe_feeds.py or scripts/verify_sources.py fetched it and the evidence gate passed (valid XML, at least three items with links, timestamps, on-domain links, and Bengali headlines for Bengali publications); the per-source notes record the measured evidence and the date. Publishers that answer 403 or publish no feed stay in the directory as website-only entries, and the app never presents their headlines as available. The curated reading set is a presentation choice and covers only publishers whose feeds verified.
